summary: Offset plus smoothed follow. Works for 2D and 3D because it is only that.
overview: Assign a target and it keeps a world-space offset from it, smoothed. Deliberately nothing more, which is why it serves both 2D and 3D: for 2D, put your usual camera distance in the offset's Z and lock Z so gameplay depth never drifts.
useCases: A 2D platformer or top-down camera following the player.
A fixed-angle 3D camera that trails a vehicle or character.
Any object that should trail another smoothly, not only cameras.

params.tuning: A rate, not a duration, and frame-rate independent. Higher is snappier; there is no setting for "arrives in N seconds" because exponential smoothing never quite arrives.
Turn on for 2D. Most 2D targets never move in Z, so without it a stray Z on the target drags the camera out of its plane.

gotchas.title: The offset is world space, not local
gotchas.body: It does not rotate with the target, so the camera will not orbit as the target turns. That is what makes it a fixed-angle camera — use PlayerCameraRig if you want orbiting.
